translations.Whether the published agenda has been op: Whether the published agenda has been opened for revision and a new version is being prepared.
translations.Whether the step is mandatory. A mandato: Whether the step is mandatory. A mandatory step blocks the offboarding from reaching `completed` until it is `completed` itself; revoke-groups is always mandatory.
Whether the step is mandatory. A mandatory step blocks the onboarding from reaching `completed` until it is `completed` itself.
translations.Whether the support threshold is a fract: Whether the support threshold is a fraction of the body or an absolute count.
translations.Whether this body may be assigned new wo: Whether this body may be assigned new work. Independent of termStart/termEnd: a body can sit inside its term and be suspended, or be past its term and still finishing open cases, so availability cannot be derived from the dates. Unrelated to the schema-level x-openregister.active flag, which says nothing about an individual body.
Whether this holder may be reappointed.
translations.Whether this meeting still relies on the: Whether this meeting still relies on the legacy meeting type list.
translations.Whether this member sits from OUTSIDE th: Whether this member sits from OUTSIDE the administrative organ: i.e. is not employed by it. Awb 7:13(2) requires this of the chair of an objection advisory committee. NOT the same question as `independenceStatus`, which encodes corporate-governance independence and cannot carry an employment relationship.
translations.Whether this position seats a representa: Whether this position seats a representative delegated by a composing body.
translations.Whether this route has to conclude befor: Whether this route has to conclude before its subject counts as cleared. Defaults to true, because a route somebody bothered to start is a route somebody is waiting on, and the safe default for a clearance question is the one that blocks (REQ-AR-014).
translations.Whether this stage must be taken. COPIED: Whether this stage must be taken. COPIED from the ApprovalRoute step at instantiation, deliberately: reading it from the route at decision time would give a different answer whenever the template changed after a subject started travelling it.
translations.Whether this type is offered when creati: Whether this type is offered when creating a meeting.
translations.Which consecutive term in this position: Which consecutive term in this position this hold is.
translations.Which declared meaning of silence produc: Which declared meaning of silence produced this action. An undeclared property is DROPPED by the importer without an error, so a lapse row would otherwise be unable to say why it happened (REQ-AR-017).
translations.Which rule produced this stage's actor,: Which rule produced this stage's actor, when a rule did. Kept so the stage can answer why this person was asked, which a resolved name on its own cannot (REQ-AR-012).
translations.Who meetings of this kind are for. The m: Who meetings of this kind are for. The meeting calendar filters on it.
translations.Who signs this record, in the order they: Who signs this record, in the order they sign. The first entry signs first.
translations.Who the meeting is for, taken from its k: Who the meeting is for, taken from its kind of meeting.
translations.Who the rule is read against, copied fro: Who the rule is read against, copied from the step.
translations.Who the substitute is. Both they and the: Who the substitute is. Both they and the original actor may act, and whichever acts first closes the stage.
translations.Who this approval is waiting on. An open: Who this approval is waiting on. An open action with no assignee is an approval nobody has been asked for, which is how a route sits still for a week with nothing to show for it.
translations.Who withdrew it. A withdrawal by the dec: Who withdrew it. A withdrawal by the deciding body and a withdrawal by the party who asked are different acts with different consequences, and a record that does not say which is not a record (REQ-DWP-005).
translations.Why a granted approval is no longer good: Why a granted approval is no longer good. `basis-changed` is the system's own: what was approved was edited afterwards. `by-actor` is the person taking it back. A history that cannot tell the two apart cannot answer who is responsible for the reopened step.
translations.Why the asking body handled the answer t: Why the asking body handled the answer that way.
translations.Why the membership ends. Free text: end: Why the membership ends. Free text: end of term, resignation, relocation, death, or whatever else an organisation records.
translations.Why. Read by the person who receives the: Why. Read by the person who receives the withdrawal, so it is written for them.
translations.Widened with `lapsed`, the verb for a st: Widened with `lapsed`, the verb for a step that moved because its deadline passed rather than because somebody acted. Without it the row fails validation and the lapse leaves no trace (REQ-AR-017).
translations.Widened with `system`. A lapse is record: Widened with `system`. A lapse is recorded as an action by the system and never under the silent actor's name, because an action carrying their name reads exactly like one they took. Fragments union list values, so this ADDS to the enum rather than replacing it (REQ-AR-017).
translations.Wire buttons here to create records, ope: Wire buttons here to create records, open lists, or deep links. Use the sidebar for Settings and Documentation.
translations.Withdrawing removes the published record: Withdrawing removes the published record from the public surface and retracts the OpenCatalogi publication. A reason is required and recorded in the audit trail (WOO correction duty).
